name: Cultural Heritage Sites of Ancient Khuttal
description: In southern Tajikistan, between the Panj and Vakhsh rivers, lie eleven archaeological sites from the medieval kingdom of Khuttal. From the 7th to 16th centuries it traded salt, gold, silver and horses along the Silk Roads. Visitors can explore the remains of Buddhist temples, palaces, fortified towns, workshop quarters and caravanserais, where travellers once rested.
